# Test files

Files Lincoln must read, used by `tests/files.test.mjs`.

* `letter.doc`, `letter.odt`, `staff.xls`, `staff.ods`, `deck.ppt`, `deck.pptx`: made for these tests (the old formats
  converted by LibreOffice).
* `wordperfect51.wp`, `wordperfect6.wpd`, `pages2013.pages`, `winmail.dat`: test documents from Apache Tika
  (https://github.com/apache/tika), Apache License 2.0.
